svg.title: Representation-specific semantic audit
svg.desc: Schematic mechanism for the TKDE manuscript. Matched frozen text representations, event-preserving content interventions, independently selected condition models, fixed aligned checkpoints and known-signal calibration. All traces and vector symbols are conceptual illustrations.
